purpose: Teach: せっせと/おっちゃん/大方/易く/総じて/ひそか/カワイイ/凄まじい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、私達もせっせと働いてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we're working hard at this, aren't we?
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Slow, steady rhythm. The voice of someone noticing a shared effort with quiet gratitude. Gentle smile underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、市場のおっちゃんが新鮮な魚を分けて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The market vendor gave us some fresh fish today.
lines.style: Bright, easy delivery. A small lift in the voice at the good news. Conversational, as if sharing a small gift of information. No fanfare, genuine pleasure.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、大方のお客様は新メニューに好意的ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Most customers seem to like the new menu.
lines.style: Calm satisfaction. Measured pace. Speaking from observation, not hope. A slight nod in the voice—confirmation of something done well. Understated contentment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、易く作れるレシピにしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I kept the recipes simple so it'd be easy to make.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical tone. Direct but not curt. The voice of someone who thinks through problems beforehand. Slight warmth underneath the efficiency.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、総じて満足してくれてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Customers really do seem happy with it overall.
lines.style: Gentle reaffirmation. Slower than before. The voice of someone absorbing good news, turning it over. Soft and reflective, not triumphant.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がひそかに新メニューの噂をしてくれてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And customers have been quietly talking about the new menu.
lines.style: Pleased but careful—almost conspiratorial. A softer attack than before. The delight of overhearing something good being said about your work. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しいエプロン、カワイイね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your new apron is really cute.
lines.style: Direct, genuine. A warm compliment delivered without performance. Brief, clear, the kind of thing said because it's true and worth noticing. Affectionate ease.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、繁忙期は凄まじい忙しさだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The busy season is absolutely relentless, though.
lines.style: Wry acknowledgment. A slight laugh underneath the words. Tired but not defeated—the voice of someone who knows chaos and is already plotting through it. Rueful honesty.
